difficulty_reason: For immersions Z -> Y -> X with X locally Noetherian, if the composition j circ i is a regular immersion and i is perfect, the lemma concludes both i and j are regular immersions — the Noetherian factorization law for regular immersions. The retained proof is written: over a locally Noetherian scheme the four flavours of regular immersion (regular, Koszul-regular, quasi-regular, H_1-regular) coincide and regularity can be tested on local rings (Divisors, lemma Noetherian-scheme-regular-ideal); the statement then becomes the pure local-algebra theorem of Divided Power Algebra, lemma regular-sequence (in a local ring, if f_1,...,f_r generate a regular-sequence quotient and the intermediate quotient is perfect, both stages are regular sequences — the DPA lemma carrying the Koszul-complex analysis). Retained author proof at lines 18027-18034.

dedup.scope: Factorization of Noetherian regular immersions through perfect intermediates.
